about: The likely next tools by the document's own state, for the "next" hint of session_state and the health check and for tool_groups { now: true } (agentlink/nexthint.py). Each entry is a rule: when (facts that must all hold; a list means any of its values), unless (facts of which none may hold), suggest (up to four tools, likeliest first, each with a few words on why) and weight (0-100: the heaviest matching rules come first; a failing recompute 100, the selection 80-90, a sketch in edit 70-85, an assembly 45, or 72 in the Assembly workbench, a drawing page in front 75, the body's progress 30-66). The facts, read cheaply from the document and the window: document (empty | objects), failing (true | false), selection (edge | face | vertex | object), selectionIn (body: the picked object is a Part Design body or one of its features | other), editing (sketch | other), dof (free | full), page (true: a drawing page is in front), assembly (empty | unjointed | jointed), body (none | empty | sketch-empty | sketch-open | sketch-closed | features: its newest sketch that no feature uses has no geometry, open wires or only closed ones; else it has features), features (none | some), lastFeature (the tip's type in lower case: pad, pocket, fillet …), workbench (FreeCAD's class name). A tool that is not installed, or whose FreeCAD command is on the active workbench's toolbars and reports itself inactive, is passed over; at most three are said. An add-on adds rules for its own tools with NEXT on its family module ({ id: entry } of this same shape).
